pkgmetadata.longdescription: Native KDE Connect implementation for the COSMIC desktop, written in Rust. Provides a background service and a COSMIC panel applet for pairing with phones, clipboard sync, notifications, file sharing, SMS and more. Conflicts with the official KDE Connect because both use port 1716.

use.flag: When building in release or debug mode, only add line tables instead of full debug info.
Build with the maximum-optimization release profile (codegen-units=1).
